description_en: Queries application metadata by ID and type
description_zh: 根据ID和类型查询编码映射内容
kebab_example: aliyun arms query-app-metadata --meta-ids 4c9dd447,3c76c565 --meta-type sql --pid ggxw4lnjuz@54364d85b000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time-ms 1 --end-time-ms 1 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryAppMetadata

parameters.help_en:
The metadata IDs. Use a comma (,) to separate multiple IDs.

You can obtain the exception ID on the **exception analysis** page of the target application in the ARMS console
parameters.help_zh:
元数据ID列表，多个ID之间用英文半角逗号（,）分隔。

您可以在ARMS控制台目标应用的**异常分析**页面获取异常ID
parameters.name: meta_ids

parameters.help_en:
The type of the metadata. Valid values:

- sql: Retrieves the SQL statement by sqlId.

- exception: Retrieves the exception stack by exceptionId
parameters.help_zh:
元数据类型：

- sql：通过sqlId获取SQL语句
- exception：通过exceptionId返回异常堆栈
parameters.name: meta_type

parameters.help_en: The application ID. To obtain the ID, call the **ListTraceApps** operation
parameters.help_zh: 应用的ID标识串，可以通过**ListTraceApps**接口获取
parameters.name: pid
